Subject: KubeCon on-site demo — clock mismatch at hotel / need to reconfirm

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Quick note ahead of tomorrow's 10:00 demo. I'm on-site in Barcelona and noticed a potential timezone mismatch between the calendar event and what my phone/hotel clock is showing. The calendar event is listed as 10:00 PDT / 18:00 CET (same wall time but different labels) — because of the recent US DST switch we've seen the labels flip for some folks.

Can you confirm you plan to join at 18:00 local (CEST) at the conference lobby table? If easier we can lock this to UTC (16:00 UTC) to avoid device-time confusion. I'm attaching the short runbook and an .ics with the local meeting link.

If you prefer a quick swap to a midday slot that works for the Acme team, cc'ing David to propose alternatives.

Thanks — looking forward to a short on-site walkthrough (20 min + Q&A).

—
Kimberly Park

Given the confusion, we are happy to confirm 16:00 UTC if that is the UTC anchor you suggested — that would be 17:00 CET for us, which is easier.

Can we make it 16:00 UTC and confirm the meeting location (booth #G12 or lobby table)?
